definitions.gloss: to become depressed, to brood, to mope, to feel gloomy
definitions.explanation: To sink into a state of gloom or depression, withdrawing from activity and social interaction. Implies shutting oneself off emotionally and dwelling on negative feelings.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ずっと→ずっと：00912_zutto⟧{塞|ふさ}ぎ{込|こ}んで⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: She has been feeling down for a long time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{失恋|しつれん}→失恋：04195_shitsuren⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{塞|ふさ}ぎ{込|こ}んでしまった。
examples.english: After the breakup, I shut myself away in my room and moped.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{落|お}ちた→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧⟦ショック→ショック：03847_shokku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{何日|なんにち}→何日：23870_nannichi⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{塞|ふさ}ぎ{込|こ}んで⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{励|はげ}まし⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{元気|げんき}→元気：00696_genki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{戻|もど}した→取り戻す：04223_torimodosu⟧。
examples.english: I was so shocked by failing the exam that I moped for days, but I regained my spirits thanks to my friend's encouragement.

notes:
USAGE:
Often used in the ～て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ form to describe an ongoing state of gloom: {塞|ふさ}ぎ{込|こ}んで⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ (is moping / has been depressed). The ～⟦{込|こ}む→込む：00719_komu⟧ ending adds the nuance of sinking deeply into a state.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{塞|ふさ}ぎ{込|こ}む: shut oneself away in one's room
- ⟦ずっと→ずっと：00912_zutto⟧{塞|ふさ}ぎ{込|こ}む: mope for a long time
- ⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{塞|ふさ}ぎ{込|こ}む: brood alone

SIMILAR WORDS:
{塞|ふさ}ぎ{込|こ}む implies withdrawal and brooding — a deeper state than simply feeling sad. ⟦{落|お}ち{込|こ}む→落ち込む：05750_ochikomu⟧ (to feel down) is more common in everyday speech and less intense. {沈|しず}み{込|こ}む (to sink into gloom) is similar but emphasizes the sinking quality.
